title: issue-pipeline-handoff/v1
description: What tier 1 of the issue pipeline hands tier 2 for one issue (.github/workflows/issue-pipeline.yml). A deterministic step after tier 1 builds it from the issue as tier 1 left it and records it on the issue between <!-- issue-pipeline-handoff key="owner/repo#N" --> and <!-- /issue-pipeline-handoff -->. Before an issue reaches the tier-2 work order, the queue builder rebuilds the handoff from the issue as it stands, validates it, and checks that the recorded one is bound to this issue; a failure moves the issue to agent:blocked with the reason. Three rules need the issue being checked and are enforced by pipeline_contracts.validate_handoff rather than by this schema: `issue` is that issue, `owner_repo` is the repo it lives in and is owned by the hub's owner, and `evidence.key` (when present) names that issue.

owner_repo.description: The repo that owns the code and gets the pull request: the issue's own repo.

acceptance_criteria.description: The issue's checkbox criteria, verbatim and in order (pipeline_contracts.parse_acceptance_criteria). Tier 3's verdict is judged against the same list.

evidence.description: The last evidence bundle tools/issue-evidence.sh posted on the issue, read only from a trusted author (owner, member, collaborator or a bot), or null when none was built.

url.description: The comment that carries the bundle.

built_at.description: When the handoff was built (UTC, ISO 8601).
